scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: The discovery club
scenes.caption: The discovery club is ready to show its work. Its draft page contains a home address, an unexpected login link and a photo app request for contacts. The shared laptop is also still signed in under a learner’s name.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: A problem to solve
scenes.caption: Meera wants to fix the address and publish immediately. Kabir points out that one repair does not remove every problem. The team makes a short checklist connecting each risk with an action and a way to check the action worked.
scenes.speech: Meera wants to fix the address and publish immediately. Kabir points out that one repair does not remove every problem. The team makes a short checklist connecting each risk with an action and a way to check the action worked.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Try the idea
scenes.caption: A teacher checks the edited draft through the known school route. The team denies unrelated access, ends the shared session and verifies the public preview. They keep only fictional practice evidence, rather than collecting account secrets or personal messages for their review.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Choose and explain
scenes.caption: The login detour, contacts request and open shared session remain. The teacher has not yet reviewed the edited version. Compare the actions, then inspect the explanation before moving on.
scenes.speech: The login detour, contacts request and open shared session remain. The teacher has not yet reviewed the edited version. Compare the actions, then inspect the explanation before moving on.
scenes.dialogue: Is removing the address enough to publish?

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: See the consequence
scenes.caption: Finish each relevant repair and check the final draft with the teacher. Fixing one visible problem does not establish that the whole plan is ready.
scenes.speech: Finish each relevant repair and check the final draft with the teacher. Fixing one visible problem does not establish that the whole plan is ready.
scenes.dialogue: Match each risk to a suitable repair.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Your turn in the lab
scenes.caption: Now open the practice lab. Work through a combined review, then evidence of repairs, then a changed audience. Test each answer, read feedback and try again when needed. Save your evidence and explain one decision in your own words.
